paragraphs: Rava bar Mahasya said that Rav said: Shabbat 10b; Megillah 16b. He said that R' Hama bar Gurya said that Rav said: Shabbat there, many expositions. Rav Hisda gave him gifts so that he would tell him teachings in Rav's name, there. In Ta'anit 12b: Rabbah bar Mahasya.
